budget_saving_tips: Repurpose ceremony flowers: Move ceremony arch and aisle bouquets to the sweetheart table and bar
Limit open bar offerings to 2 signature cocktails plus curated wine and beer, bypassing expensive top-shelf spirits
Choose in-season local blooms over imported florals to reduce florist costs by 20-30%
Schedule dinner service as family-style or upscale buffet rather than multi-course plated dining
